videos.title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools
videos.summary: Building user interfaces for AI workflows is messy, and standard component libraries often fall short. This talk breaks down real-world architectural patterns and failure modes when building intent-driven frontend experiences.

videos.title: Agent Spending Without Controls — Rodrigo Coelho & Pranav Maheshwari, Edge & Node
videos.summary: If you are hooking LLMs up to external APIs and payment rails, controlling runaway spend is a critical engineering problem. Learn how developers are implementing practical control layers and skill files to govern autonomous agent transactions.

videos.title: Agentic video understanding in Gemini
videos.summary: Processing heavy multimedia with LLMs can burn through API credits rapidly if done naively. This deep dive shows fullstack engineers how to implement agentic chunking and sampling to dramatically lower token costs while boosting extraction accuracy.

videos.title: [S03:E74] TAK MAMPU ambil takaful, isu DUIT atau PRIORITI? - Azam Yusof & Mohamad Saifudin
videos.summary: Navigating financial safety nets early in your career can be confusing, especially when balancing tight cash flows. This episode breaks down how Takaful, Hibah, and Wakaf function practically in Malaysia to protect your family without breaking your budget.

videos.title: [S01:E22]  Credit Card vs BNPL:  Mana sebenarnya lebih bahaya? - Norliza Rahmat & Fairuz Izwan
videos.summary: As a junior engineer earning your first professional salary, modern credit facilities and 'Buy Now Pay Later' schemes can quietly erode your savings. This breakdown gives practical advice on managing cash flow, avoiding debt traps, and building healthy credit habits in Malaysia.

videos.title: #113 | Never Quit On Your Goals (Leon Jala)
videos.summary: Starting out in tech requires staying disciplined even after the initial enthusiasm wears off. Leon Jala shares a structured framework for relentless execution alongside candid lessons from handling harsh feedback early in his career.

videos.title: Is Any Income Actually Halal Anymore? | Signs of the Hour Ep. 15 | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: In an economy driven by interest, aggressive speculation, and financial gray areas, ensuring your income is truly pure is a vital spiritual priority. Dr. Omar Suleiman explores the Prophetic teachings on wealth, barakah, and how to maintain ethical integrity in your career.

videos.title: Everyone Around You Is On A Clock Too | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: When you are buried in code sprints and career building, it is easy to defer being present for your parents and family until things 'calm down.' This short reminder delivers a poignant spiritual wake-up call on the urgency of cherishing the people around you before time runs out.

videos.title: Niantic Spatial CTO: How The Best Engineers Solve Problems You'd Give Up On
videos.summary: Hearing how legendary systems builders tackle seemingly impossible technical roadblocks is invaluable for a junior dev. Brian McClendon breaks down the debugging mental models, engineering tenacity, and team standards that separate great software engineers from average ones.

videos.title: How new staff engineers build judgment without years of experience
videos.summary: When AI tooling makes writing boilerplate code abundant, your real career leverage comes from system judgment and architectural trade-offs. This concise insight explains how junior developers can intentionally cultivate high-level engineering taste early in their careers.

videos.title: LIVE: Uncle Bob on Software Fundamentals in the Age of AI
videos.summary: As an early-career engineer using AI coding assistants, it is easy to let core engineering rigor slip. Matt Pocock and Uncle Bob debate why clean architecture, solid boundaries, and testing discipline matter more than ever when orchestrating AI agents.

videos.title: New Skills! v1.2 brings /wait-what, /writing-for-agents, and fixes /grill-me
videos.summary: Supercharge your local AI coding workflows with concrete, usable agent skills. Matt Pocock demonstrates hands-on configurations and tooling that streamline infrastructure provisioning, context management, and technical vetting directly inside terminal-based coding agents.

videos.title: /wayfinder: Nothing is too big to plan anymore
videos.summary: Managing large codebases and complex fullstack features with AI often falls apart during the planning stage. This video demonstrates a structured workflow to decompose ambiguous software projects into verifiable, multi-session agent execution maps.

videos.title: The Palestinian Genius Revolutionizing How Startups Operate ($23M Company)
videos.summary: Discover how a Muslim software engineer built a multi-million-dollar automated cloud cost optimization platform from the ground up. This interview covers both the engineering reality of cutting cloud infrastructure bills and the entrepreneurial journey of building a venture-backed tech company.

videos.title: Max Junestrand: You Need The Willingness To Learn Faster Than Anyone Else
videos.summary: Scaling a software product from initial prototype to $100M ARR requires extreme iteration velocity and deep customer empathy. Legora's founder delivers a masterclass in how software builders can accelerate their learning curve and ship features that enterprise users actually pay for.
